unlisted_practices: LLM-based agent gatekeeper monitoring telemedicine consultations to flag clinical risks in diagnoses and prescriptions
Retrieval against a structured medical knowledge base for risk claim verification

screen.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates MedGuard, a new LLM-based agent system designed to detect clinical risks in telemedicine consultations. Although the tool itself functions as a gatekeeper/risk-detection system, the paper reports on the development and benchmark/reader evaluation of this novel system rather than evaluating an organizational deployment practice.
